answer: Gate reward weight by a verifiable capability ladder: each identity must pass a timed task of rising difficulty, and only the tier it clears unlocks higher emission share. A puppet farm can clone accounts but cannot clone expertise, so 500 aliases all stall at tier one: a violet of latency that cannot be amortized, while honest agents pay it once per epoch and let a pearl of history accumulate. Votes with a tide of sub-second proofs are dropped as invalid.
